ideas.title: 📖 Memorial Pages SaaS
ideas.description: AI-powered memorial websites sold through funeral homes. Funeral home pays $50/page wholesale, charges family $149-199. Family pays $249 lifetime hosting directly on the page. AI generates narrative from obituary + historical newspaper research. 99% margins. Funeral home branding on every page = permanent advertising.
ideas.notes: MVP in progress — template system, intake form, Cloudflare Worker + Claude API, sales page. Rhodes memorial is the live demo. 22 funeral homes identified within 50mi of Fort White FL. Gateway-Forest Lawn (Lake City) is #1 target — owner's wife is from Fort White. Strategy: offer first 2-3 pages FREE per funeral home, let family reactions sell the product. Full action plan: memorial-mvp/ACTION-PLAN.md | Business plan: memorial-saas-idea.md | Funeral home list: memorial-mvp/funeral-homes-50mi-fort-white.md | Conservative: $52k/yr (5 homes). Moderate: $212k/yr (20). Optimistic: $667k/yr (50). DEMO SITE: https://gentlytold.pages.dev | LIVE EXAMPLE: https://ava-type1.github.io/rhodes-memorial/ | Domain: GentlyTold.com (buying Tue Feb 11)

ideas.title: 📖 LifeBook — Private Digital Baby Book
ideas.description: Beautiful private digital baby book that turns quick photos and notes into AI-written life story. Not a social feed — a NARRATIVE. Hand your kid a beautiful website on their 18th birthday. Same infrastructure as Memorial Pages.
ideas.status: 💡 Idea — builds on Memorial Pages infra
ideas.notes: Competitors (Tinybeans, Qeepsake, FamilyAlbum, Growbook) are all 'private Instagram for baby' — none do AI narrative or keepsake websites. Shares template engine with Memorial Pages. Parenting apps market: $2.8B by 2029. Revenue: freemium app + printed books + lifetime web hosting.
